source: Perseverance MEDA (PDS Atmospheres Node, mars2020_meda bundle): DER_PS pressure, CAL_ATS air temperature (mean of ATS1-5), DER_WS wind, DER_TIRS long-wave irradiance. Dust tau: Mastcam-Z (Lemmon, Mendeley 10.17632/gktjp9jptb.2), 630 nm channel, daily median of the nearest measured sol.
notes: Archived data, not live. Label charts with: Perseverance MEDA, sol N.
Hourly arrays are indexed by Local True Solar Time hour 0-23; null = no data that hour.
pressurePa = [lowest, mean, highest] of all 1 Hz readings. airTempC = [min, mean, max] of the hourly means. windMS = [mean, 99th percentile] of all readings.

The wind sensor was damaged on sol 313, during the dust storm (Lemmon et al. 2022); Hueso et al. 2023 report the wind sensors were partly damaged in two dust devil encounters. No valid wind after 13:42 LTST on sol 313.
groundTemp/skyTemp are brightness temperatures from TIRS (ground emissivity 0.98 assumed).
MEDA logs 12 h per sol on a normal cadence (odd/even hours alternate), so some sols miss hours.
